title: LoRA Speedrun – a public wall-clock leaderboard for fine-tuning techniques
summary: LoRA Speedrun is a public leaderboard that benchmarks different LoRA fine-tuning techniques by measuring actual wall-clock time performance, providing empirical data to help practitioners compare speed across various LoRA implementations and configurations.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of standardized real-world performance benchmarks for comparing different LoRA fine-tuning approaches.
why_valuable: Enables data-driven decision making when selecting LoRA configurations by providing transparent, community-verified speed benchmarks.
